title: Accessible name and role

blocks.md:
## A button should be a button

A `div` with a click is a trap for keyboard and screen readers. Use `<button>`. The **accessible name** is often the text content, or `aria-label`.

Set the button’s label to `Call north` using `textContent` — not `innerHTML` for this plain phrase. The call switch on the desk needs a name a reader can speak.

blocks.promptMd: A `div` with `onclick` is a good button?

choices.md: No — it misses role, keyboard, and name by default

blocks.promptMd: A `div` with `onclick` is a good button.
blocks.explainMd: A div has no button role, no default keyboard activation, and often no accessible name.

blocks.promptMd: > `#call` is a button. Set its accessible name (text) to `Call north`.

hintLadder.md: `#call` is already a real button. Do not replace it with a div.
The accessible name here is the button’s text.

description: A control needs a name and a role a screen reader can use.
